_note: Departure schedule for the on-site booking system. The generator (build.mjs → availabilityFor) expands this into concrete dated departures per tour, written to /data/availability/<tourId>.json and read by the booking widget. This is the source of truth for WHICH DAYS and TIMES each tour runs and how many seats are open — it replaces reading availability from WordPress. Replace these placeholder patterns with the real schedule from BookingMyTour (or a supplier feed) when available; until then every bookable tour still gets a full, honest forward calendar. Weekdays: 1=Mon, 2=Tue, 3=Wed, 4=Thu, 5=Fri, 6=Sat, 7=Sun. 'times' are local departure/first-pickup times (empty = all-day attraction, no fixed time). 'capacity' is seats offered online per departure. 'seasons' multiply the fare for dates inside a window (priceFactor 1 = no change); leave empty to keep fixed prices.
